lenses.description: Sony's full-frame cine-style power zoom, a parfocal constant-f/4 lens with a servo zoom rocker, OSS stabilization and independent zoom, focus and iris rings. Built for video on E-mount cinema and mirrorless bodies, it holds focus through the zoom and delivers smooth, quiet powered moves, bridging still-lens convenience and cine-zoom behaviour.

Sony's flagship wide-angle G Master prime for full-frame E-mount, pairing high across-frame resolution from XA and ED optics with the smooth, rounded rendering the G Master line is known for, in a notably compact body. A fast, versatile wide favoured for reportage, street, environmental portraiture and low-light work, and equally at home on stills and video.

lenses.description: The first-generation G Master fast telephoto zoom for full-frame E-mount, long a staple for portrait, event and sports shooters on Sony bodies. It delivers G Master resolution and creamy bokeh across the range with in-lens optical stabilization, and is optically tuned to hold focus with minimal breathing so it doubles comfortably for video. The heaviest of the F2.8 70-200 line, with a constant length that aids handling.

lenses.description: The second-generation G Master fast telephoto zoom for full-frame E-mount, rebuilt around a lighter optical formula and a faster XD linear-motor AF system.
